announcements.title: VerusMiner v6 is here 🎉
announcements.description: A friendlier, smarter release: Mining power profiles, better phone setup, history graphs, themes & languages, and a smoother home experience. Tap for the full story and download page.
announcements.content:
# VerusMiner v6 is here

Thanks for mining with us. Version 6 is a big quality-of-life release — easier to set up, easier to keep online overnight, and clearer about how your phone is performing.

## What’s new

### Mining power (new)
Pick a simple profile instead of guessing thread counts:

- **Balanced** — everyday mining with about half your cores
- **Performance** — prefers faster cores when your phone has them
- **Cooler** — fewer cores, less heat, gentler on battery
- **Custom** — full control when you want it

Detect CPU topology once in Device Info, then profiles can apply smart defaults (including temperature and battery pauses).

### Stay connected overnight (new)
**Keep mining connected** is a short checklist for battery, Wi‑Fi, and OEM power settings so the pool doesn’t drop when the screen is off. Open it anytime from Settings before a long session.

### History & graphs
- Session history with ranges (1h → 30d, custom)
- Live charts while mining: hashrate, temperature, shares, difficulty
- When mining stops, home can still show your **last session** graphs

### Smoother mining UX
- Clearer home and bottom navigation
- Accepted/hour and other metrics that are easier to read
- Notice if the app was force-closed while mining (so you know why it stopped)
- Refreshed onboarding and Quickstart for first-time setup

### Look & language
- Multiple themes (including community styles)
- More languages via refreshable language packs — pull the latest from Tools / General settings

## Tips after updating
- Open **Device Info** → detect CPU topology (stop mining first)
- Try a **Mining power** profile on your miner setting
- Run through **Keep mining connected** once on each phone
- Refresh languages/themes if you want the latest remote packs

## Download & details
Use the link below for the official VerusMiner page (Google Play).

Happy hashing — and thank you for supporting the Verus community.
